1) **PASS** – Layout is clean; text is centered and fully visible within the dark player, with no overlapping or cut-off elements.
2) **FAIL** – The large red heart animation overlaps and obscures the selected answer text ("You") and partially covers the option below it ("Not you").
3) **FAIL** – The bottom of the share sheet (including channel icons like "Messages", "WhatsApp" etc.) is cut off by the edge of the image frame.
4) **PASS** – The "Saved" segment is active, the template card is fully rendered, and all text/elements are properly aligned without overlap or clipping.
